verdict.rationale: Changelog entries confirm Apple Pay support for subscriptions via Braintree and a PayPal gateway for direct card payments, showing some accelerated-wallet capability, but there is no documentation of Google Pay, general (non-subscription) Apple Pay checkout, or platform one-click wallets. Missing for 10: Google Pay support, Apple Pay for standard one-time checkout (not just subscriptions), platform one-click checkout evidence, and any independent confirmation of frictionless wallet UX.
